increment_paragraph: **RETURN-STRICT-MEMBER-NULL-UNTRACKED-ROOT** (USER DECISION 2026-11-24: "launch both cards"; gateway rule 74v, registered by rule 74t's card; `QCore.ReturnStrictMemberNull`; [report](../../reports/return-strict-member-null/README.md)). `long w(void) { const struct s *p = 0; return p->n; }`, `struct s *w(void) { … return p->next; }` and its `(void *)` cast were `Safe`, while `return p->n + 1;` (family S) and `long x = p->n; return x;` are `Unknown` (`unknown_alias:p`). The admitting route was not the strict `Returned` rule or its `Decides` widening, as registered. Both refuse a written root. It was card B01's opaque member read in `return_expression_instruction`, asked before family S. That route admitted C02-P's `OpaqueValue` into the return place for a single `ROOT -> FIELD` read over a never-bound root, with no obligation for the dereferenced root. `member_read_base` now lowers that read to family S's `IndirectScalarAccess`, with the root as its only base and its C02-P-ALIAS reading. A `.` read of a record value keeps the `OpaqueValue`, and any other spelling declines to the later routes. The exit is still a `NoOp`. B01 admitted every expression it read, so nothing admits more than at the base. An unbound formal, an uninitialised local, a copy or member read of a formal and a guarded root keep `Safe`, and tracked roots and `&p->n` keep their verdicts. The change is pinned end to end (5 null rows, 6 root bindings that compare the bare read with `p->n + 1`, and controls) and by `readVectors` (12 rows). The change pins fail at the base. `null_premise_custody`'s pin of `struct S *n = a->next; return n->a;` at no premise held the gap. It now names `n`, as `n->a + 1` already did. Opt-in `current --monkey-linked` over Fluent Bit 046accf6 moves no status (1,171 / 2 / 3,623 / 8 on both sides). Two rows (`src/flb_input_chunk.c::flb_input_chunk_get_name`, the unit reported twice) stay `Safe` but now rest on a named rule-14n premise for `ch`. The prediction was 0 to 5 `Safe -> Unknown` moves among 8 census candidates. The pinned routes need inputs this host lacks and were not run. Registered: RETURN-CALL-ACTUAL-NULL-UNTRACKED-ROOT and UNTRACKED-BASE-NULL-JOIN-DISCHARGE.

ledger.why: Discharged by RETURN-STRICT-MEMBER-NULL-UNTRACKED-ROOT (rule 74v). Reachability: at the base 497c859fc, `long w(void) { const struct s *p = 0; return p->n; }`, `struct s *w(void) { const struct s *p = 0; return p->next; }` and `void *w(void) { … return (void *)p->next; }` were `Safe` end to end (report §1). The route is card B01's opaque member read in crates/qcore-c-gateway/src/legacy_return_routes.rs `return_expression_instruction`, not the strict `Returned` rule or its `Decides` widening. Both refuse a root `FunctionTypes::may_bind` reports written. An unwritten root (a formal or an uninitialised local) has no binding, so family S's obligation discharges for it anyway (report §2). B01 took the classifier's `OpaqueValue { alias_read: None }` (C02-P's opaque field read over a root `UntrackedBases::never_bound` admits) with no obligation for the dereferenced root. `member_read_base` lowers `ROOT -> FIELD` to family S's `IndirectScalarAccess`, with the root as its only base and its C02-P-ALIAS reading. A `.` read keeps the `OpaqueValue`, and any other spelling declines. Only refuses more (`QCore.ReturnStrictMemberNull.the_fix_only_refuses_more`, `a_root_read_needs_its_base`, `the_bare_read_gets_family_s_verdict`). The bare forms are pinned `Unknown` (`unknown_alias:p`) end to end (crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/return_strict_member_null.rs), with each change pin failing at the base. Unbound formals, uninitialised locals, copies and member reads of formals, guarded roots, tracked roots and `&p->n` keep their verdicts. The opt-in corpus moves no status. Two `Safe` rows now name a rule-14n premise (report §5). The pinned routes need inputs this host lacks and were not run.

ledger.title: A borrowed call actual read through a null untracked root is `Safe`, in a statement and in a return
ledger.text: RETURN-STRICT-MEMBER-NULL-UNTRACKED-ROOT found, by an end-to-end probe at its base 497c859fc and at its tip 8434d92a3 (report §2 and §7, `private/rsm/reach/census-*.log`), that with `long k_read(int fd, void *b, __SIZE_TYPE__ n)` contracted all-`Borrowed` with a `None` result, both `long w(void) { const struct s *p = 0; return k_read(p->n, 0, 0); }` and `… k_read(p->n, 0, 0); return 0; }` are `Safe`. The actual `p->n` dereferences the null `p`. C02-P's borrowed actual (crates/qcore-c-gateway/src/borrowed_actual.rs) admits a `ROOT -> FIELD` actual over a never-bound root at a `Borrowed` position. It carries no base obligation for the root, which is the same premise-4 gap rule 74v closed for B01's return read. The direction is admitting. DISCHARGE: give a borrowed actual's dereferenced never-bound root family S's base obligation (the flow check refuses a possibly-null binding with `unknown_alias`), or show the access is checked elsewhere. Pin both spellings end to end and measure. A Safe -> Unknown move is possible on possibly-null roots.

ledger.title: A base joined from a null constant and an unbound formal discharges the untracked-root obligation
ledger.text: RETURN-STRICT-MEMBER-NULL-UNTRACKED-ROOT found, by an end-to-end probe at its base 497c859fc and at its tip 8434d92a3 (report §7), that `long w(const struct s *f) { const struct s *p = 0; if (f) p = f; return p->n + 1; }` (family S, `p` a base) is `Safe`, and so is the bare `return p->n;` under rule 74v. On the path where `f` is null, `p` is still the null constant at the read. Meanwhile `const struct s *p = 0; return p->n + 1;` is `Unknown` (`unknown_alias:p`). The flow check's base obligation (`IndirectScalarAccess` bases in crates/qcore-c-gateway/src/legacy_transfer.rs) appears to read the join of a null binding and an unbound formal as discharged. The direction is admitting. DISCHARGE: keep a possibly-null binding possibly-null across the join, so the base obligation refuses it (`unknown_alias`) unless a branch proved it non-null, or show why the join is sound. Pin the two spellings and the declaration form (`long x = p->n; return x;`) end to end and measure.
